source.author: verg
source.text: Scilicet ut Turno contingat regia coniunx, nos animae viles, inhumata infletaque turba, sternamur campis.
source.text_original: Scilicet ut Turno contingat regia coniunx, / nos animae viles, inhumata infletaque turba, / sternamur campis.
source.text_english: So that Turnus may win a royal bride, shall we, worthless souls, a crowd left unburied and unwept, be laid low on the plains?

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: haccine nos animae faciles rate nubila contra mittimur?
reuse.text_original: haccine nos animae faciles rate nubila contra / mittimur?
reuse.text_english: Are we then, light-minded souls, sent in this craft against the clouds?
